findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_verifiers" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "compute" is 14200 chars, far longer than this server's median (644). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "compute" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, check_audit_exemption · Private data: get_deadlines, list_verifiers, get_quote, check_audit_exemption, share_with_openaccountants · Public sink: get_quote, share_with_openaccountants · Destructive: search_skills.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, check_audit_exemption · Private data: get_deadlines, list_verifiers, get_quote, check_audit_exemption, share_with_openaccountants · Public sink: get_quote, share_with_openaccountants · Destructive: search_skills

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
